messages:
Jordan: Support flagged a P1 from customer AstraNova 1 trial activation stuck at the SSO token step. They cant proceed past onboarding. Link to ticket T-9821 in Support.
Priya: Can someone grab the exact error? Need tier and renewal window too.
Jordan: Mid-market, renewal in ~35 days. Error from logs:
```
POST /embed/token 403 {"error":"forbidden", "reason":"tenant_mismatch"}
```
Keisha: Looks like our tenant mapping service returned an unexpected mapping. Ill check the mapping cache and the recent deploys. Running `curl -s http://mapping-svc/tenants/astra` now. ETA 20m.
Mateo: If mapping service is bad we can short-term issue a manual token for their workspace or flip them to a temporary workspace while we fix. Which would they prefer? Jordan confirm with customer.
Jordan: Asked the customer  they want a quick workaround to continue onboarding. Prefer manual provisioning. I shared a temporary link.
csbot: T-9821 updated: severity P1, assigned to cs-oncall.
Keisha: Found stale mapping entry caused by an unexpected namespace change during yesterdays config rollout. I pushed a rollback to the mapping service and cleared the per-tenant cache: `kubectl exec -it mapping-0 -- redis-cli DEL tenant:astra`.
Keisha: Reissued token via support console and validated the embed flow succeeded end-to-end.
Jordan: Customer confirms onboarding resumed and session starts ticked back up. They were able to finish first steps.
Priya: Next steps: (1) CS to run 1:1 onboarding session with AstraNova today to rebuild trust, (2) Add tenant_id sync check to onboarding regression suite, (3) Notify Sales and AMs with a short comms note.
Mateo: Ill open a follow-up ENG ticket for a config validation CI job and tag the mapping team.
Jordan: Olivia from Sales (ccd) asked for a short apology + mitigation note. Drafted: "Were sorry for the interruption. A config rollback restored your onboarding. Weve scheduled a 1:1 to ensure everything is working and will follow up with a post-incident summary." Sending now.
Priya: Thanks everyone. Please add a brief postmortem in T-9821 and include retrospective action owners. Closing thread after postmortem created.
